class.name: PuertsWebglBackend
class.brief_description: Selects the browser JavaScript engine for Web exports.
class.description: Web-only backend using the browser's JavaScript engine and global object. Requires the browser main thread, WeakRef, FinalizationRegistry, and CSP permission for unsafe-eval. One [PuertsEnvironment] is retained until page unload; disposal and reinitialization are unsupported. Debug with browser DevTools.

method.name: _puerts_get_functions_ptr
method.description: Returns the internal function table address used by the core.
